`getSchemaSerializer` in `lib/schemas.js` does the selection. It tries the exact status code first, then the class wildcard (for example `2xx`), then `default`. Within the chosen entry, a media-type map is matched on the content type with parameters stripped, then `*/*`, and otherwise it returns `false`. Once an exact status entry exists, the lookup never falls through to `2xx` or `default`, even when no media type matches. `lib/validation.js` compiles and keys those entries (lowercasing the keys and rejecting anything that isn't a nested `Nxx` or `default`). `lib/reply.js` and `lib/error-handler.js` call the selector when serializing normal replies and error replies.
